approvedCustomerStory.storyTitle: Absolute Clarity on Coin Value in Pounds

approvedCustomerStory.customerResolution: Transparent GBP valuation and clear partner rate comparisons are displayed directly, matching her preference for precise monetary terms.
approvedCustomerStory.primaryOutcome: Gain absolute clarity on exact monetary and partner value of accumulated points.
